title: At the Playground
scene: Children of different ages playing together at a neighbourhood playground, where an older child helps a younger one who has fallen.
questions: What is happening in this picture?
How do you think the child who fell is feeling? Why?
Have you ever helped someone who was hurt? What did you do?
What are the rules we should follow at a playground?
Why is it important to help others, even people we do not know?
